sentence: The patient is a 45-year-old male diagnosed with classic Fabry disease who presented with neuropathic pain in hands and feet.
He has been on Enzyme Replacement Therapy with agalsidase beta for 18 months .
Last blood work showed eGFR of 45 mL/min with no history of stroke or kidney transplant .
The patient reports joint pain and chronic fatigue .
She has no history of cardiac hypertrophy or arrhythmia .
